cases: Verified identity precedes RPCs; requests contain only allowed metadata and clear the matching outbox
Opted-in dates, palettes and authored notes transfer with observation creation before linked notes
Incoming coordinates reach the real local journal without being echoed back as a new upload
Wrong account and unsafe configuration stop before metadata transfer
A lost response survives database reopening and retries identically before sending a later edit
Purged uploads send only retirement identifiers, followed by a version-checked deletion
An already accepted retired upload supplies its exact revision to deletion without restoring photo content
Full pull pages stop at the request budget, retain exact large revisions and resume before writing
A conflict pulls the current remote version and preserves the local record for an explicit decision
An account change while pulling rejects the old response and prevents any write into the new session
An account change during an upload cannot acknowledge the old session or lose its pending request
Authorization, invalid JSON and malformed pages leave local work intact without echoing server content
Redirects are rejected and cancellation stops before sending a request
surface: Real Chromium fetch and IndexedDB; intercepted synthetic Auth/RPC endpoints, no hosted service
